messages:
maya (CS): Heads-up — Nimbus go-live Thu. Customer is flagged as high renewal risk. We need a 1-page customer-facing checklist for prefill/caching/batching/streaming + a tiny 2-question feedback capture for the first 48h. Who can draft a lightweight runbook we can share?
sam_cs: I can draft the one-pager. Will keep it customer-friendly: prefill checklist, warm-pool steps, suggested batching defaults, streaming sanity checks, and the short feedback form. Need eng to confirm the smoke-test steps.
liam (eng-runtime): I can validate. Proposal for smoke test: 1) send 10 warmup requests to prime KV cache, 2) verify KV hit rate >80%, 3) run 30 streaming requests at ~200ms cadence and confirm streaming chunks start within SLA. I can drop a curl script we can share.
neha (PM): Please add escalation thresholds: errors >2% over 5m OR median generation latency >2s -> escalate. Also include suggested batch sizing heuristic (example: for ~512-token prompts, batch_size 8-16; for <128 tokens, batch_size 32).
sam_cs: Good call. I'll keep the technical bits in an "engineer note" section and the rest as simple steps for the customer.
liam (eng-runtime): Test script (shareable):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-1","input":"warmup","stream":true,"batch_size":8}'
```
Expectations to document: 200 OK, streaming chunks should begin within ~1500ms, and KV cache hit rate should climb above 80% after warmup. If KV hit rate stays low, advise increasing prefill requests or widening TTL.
sam_cs: Maya — I'll add a single-click script section and an "if this happens" quick troubleshooting table for customers (incl. what we'll do on our side). I'll also add the 2-question feedback form: Q1: "Did outputs meet your expectations?" (Yes / No). Q2: "If no or issues, short description." Responses post to a webhook that creates a tracking ticket.
ops-bot: Reminder: Dedicated pool warmup scheduled Wed 02:00 UTC for Nimbus account.
neha (PM): Also include a fallback path: if streaming error rate spikes, instruct customers to switch to the non-streaming endpoint and open an urgent support ticket with the trace id. Add the support link and SLA expectations.
sam_cs: I'll assemble final assets (one-pager PDF, test script, feedback link, escalation steps) and post to #customer-success + DM the Nimbus CSM by EOD.
maya (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks — this should help reduce churn risk. cc @liam (for script) @neha (for escalation language)
